text:
incident-bot: Pager: SLI degrade detected in eu-west-1 — canary failure rate for /generate rose to 6% (threshold 2%). Trigger: canary-traffic-job. Link: https://incidents.internal/1758204567

alex: Oncall Alex here, looking. I'm throttling canary traffic and will flip the rollout flag if needed.

maya: I see the spike aligns with canary deploy that included commit a1b2c3 (batching heuristic change).

sam: Can we kill the flag for eu-west-1 now?

sam: ```bash
# flip feature flag to off for eu-west
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"gatekeeper_rollout","state":"off","env":"eu-west-1"}'
```

devops-bot: Flag flip recorded — gatekeeper_rollout set to OFF in eu-west-1 by sam at 1758204720 :white_check_mark:

alex: I've reduced canary traffic to 1% and pinned routing to stable model variant. Planning single-commit rollback on canary.

emily: I'll draft a tiny hotfix reverting the batching tweak and push as a single commit to canary first. ETA ~10m.

maya: Quick check: we're seeing latency spikes (300-600ms extra tail) for a subset of long-context requests. No 5xxs, but token latency increases.

sam: Notifying CS to hold off broad customer comms until we confirm rollback effect. @cs-team please standby.

cs-team-bot: Customer notify template drafted and queued for approval by SRE. Link: https://comm.internal/drafts/1758204567

emily: Pushed hotfix commit 1758205001: "revert: batching heuristic change (a1b2c3)" and started canary deploy.

devops-bot: Canary deploy triggered for commit 1758205001 — https://deploys.internal/1758205001 (canary pool only).

alex: Monitoring SLIs... initial signs look good. Failure-rate dropping toward baseline.

maya: Observation: token latency returning to normal in canary. No regressions so far.

emily: I'll roll the single-commit revert to the rest of canary pools in 5m if metrics remain stable.

alex: Rolling out stable revert to full canary. Continuing to keep gatekeeper_rollout off.

maya: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~0.8% of requests in eu-west faced elevated token latency, no increased error rate. Most affected were long-context (>2k tokens) sequences.

sam: cs-team: please prepare a short note saying issue mitigated, no data loss, we reverted a canary change and flipped rollout flag; we'll follow up with a postmortem.

cs-team-bot: CS notification sent to impacted customers (segment: EU canary users) at 1758205090.

devops-bot: Deploy to remaining canary pools completed at 1758205102.

alex: SLIs back to normal — failure-rate ~0.9%, latency within SLOs. Closing active pager.

maya: Action items: add synthetic coverage for long-context batching, add a gating test for heuristic, and add runbook step to flip flag and throttle canary automatically on similar SLI signals.

emily: Filing follow-up tasks and will attach the rollback PR and canary metrics.

alex: Oncall handoff: I'll hand to @ben in ~20m. Leaving notes in #oncall-handoff: short description, links to deploys/metrics, CS comms.

ben: Taking handoff — I will own the follow-ups and customer comms until tomorrow morning. Ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
